model.name: Tiny ImageNet ResNet-18, small-image stem, GroupNorm-32

schedule.rule: eta_t = eta_max * t / W for t <= W; cosine from eta_max to 0 for W < t <= T

schema: phase4-reference-flux-v1; arrays entries use raw npz key names; sha256 = sha256 of C-order bytes

training.gradient_average: g = sum_r(g_r) / world_size applied once by the wrapper
